Angle between vectors — normalize, then dot

Sequel to the introductory dot-product clip: when the vectors are different sizes, divide by both magnitudes to standardize them, then dot. cos θ = (u·v)/(∥u∥∥v∥) is just û·v̂, cosine is adjacent over hypotenuse, and three textbook pairs — including u with w at exactly 90° — land on the verified cosines and unit-vector dot products.
